title: Withdrawal Accounting Inconsistencies in Two-Phase Process
description: The _totalWithdraw function ignores the passed cached amount parameter and uses current clientBalances state. Additionally, the share calculation uses principal ratio instead of share ratio, which can lead to incorrect fund distribution during total withdrawal.
rootCause: _totalWithdraw ignores the passed cached amount parameter and uses current clientBalances state; share calculation uses principal ratio instead of share ratio
impact: Users may receive incorrect amounts during totalWithdrawal. Early depositors may be disadvantaged compared to late depositors due to the incorrect share calculation methodology.
attackPath: Multiple clients deposit funds at different times
The function calculates shares using principal ratio instead of actual share ratio
Early depositors receive less than their fair share of any accrued yield
Late depositors receive a disproportionate amount
recommendation: Use the cached amount parameter as intended and calculate shares based on the actual share ratio rather than principal ratio to ensure fair distribution during total withdrawal.
